lines.zh: 我摆尾游过去，鳞片在发光。
lines.en: A stroke of my tail and my scales catch the light.

lines.zh: 这层金鳞，在水里很显眼。
lines.en: These gold scales stand out underwater.
I cruise slowly along the river bed.

lines.zh: 我贴着水面游，专等掉下来的虫。
lines.en: I swim flush with the surface, waiting for insects to fall.

lines.zh: 有一片水草在动，我绕开。
lines.en: Weeds move ahead. I go around.
I travel with the current to save effort.

lines.zh: 我的鳍往后一摆，人就前进了。
lines.en: A sweep of my fins and I move forward.

lines.zh: 这条河里，我的颜色最亮。
lines.en: In this river my color is the brightest.

lines.zh: 我贴着浅滩的石头上游过。
lines.en: I pass over the stones of the shallows.
I lift my head with my mouth at the surface.

lines.zh: 影子落在河底，一动一动。
lines.en: My shadow slips across the bed.

lines.zh: 我往深水里游，避开阳光。
lines.en: I go deeper to escape the sun.
I hang in the water, fins barely moving.
My scales look like copper in this light.
I have a leaf held in my mouth.
Insects have landed on the surface.
My barbels sweep the sandy bottom.
My shadow lies on the sand below.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，看水面上的动静。
lines.en: I lift my head and watch the surface.
The water in this river is clear.

lines.zh: 我吐出一个小小的气泡。
lines.en: I release one small bubble.
My barbels drift in the current.

lines.zh: 我在等天黑，那时虫子多。
lines.en: I wait for dark. Insects come then.

lines.zh: 岸上的根伸进水里，我绕着。
lines.en: Roots reach into the water and I circle them.
I flick my fins once.
Stones on the bed give off a shine.

lines.zh: 你站在水里，水到你的膝。
lines.en: You stand in water to your knees.
You saw me. I noticed.
I cannot hide this color.
To catch me you must be faster than the current.

lines.zh: 你的网在水里，我看得清。
lines.en: Your net is in the water and I can see it.
I swim to your legs and away again.
Do not reach. I will bolt along the bed.

lines.zh: 我跳起来的时候，声音很响。
lines.en: When I leap, it is loud.

lines.zh: 你踩的这块石头下面有我。
lines.en: I am under the stone you are standing on.

lines.zh: 你的影子一进水，我就知道了。
lines.en: The moment your shadow hits the water I know.
My gold scales catch the light in the water.
You have caught a lot of fish, I think.
I am not that sort of fish.
My teeth face inward.
You stepped back and the water settled.

lines.zh: 这里只有我们，还有几条小鱼。
lines.en: Only us here, and a few small fish.
I am leaving. Do not follow.

lines.zh: 水面上的光，正好照着我。
lines.en: The surface light falls right on me.

lines.zh: 侧线被划开了，游起来偏。
lines.en: My lateral line is cut; I swim crooked.
There is blood in the water.
I bolt a short way and stop.

lines.zh: 嘴里进了泥，我甩头吐掉。
lines.en: Mud fills my mouth; I shake it out.
I sink into the deeper shadow.

lines.zh: 疼得很清楚，水里也躲不掉。
lines.en: The pain is clear. Water does not hide it.
A fin has split.
I turn back and look at you.

lines.zh: 断掉的鳍丝还挂着，我照样游。
lines.en: A torn fin ray still trails; I swim anyway.

lines.zh: 金鳞掉了几片，沉向河底。
lines.en: A few gold scales sink toward the riverbed.
An insect fell. I look up.

lines.zh: 那条虫还在挣，我盯得紧。
lines.en: That insect is still wriggling — my eyes are locked on it.
That insect is still moving. Good.
I swallow it with barely a splash.
The feed sinks and I follow.
Your net smells of fish.
I rise and sink back down.
Not filling, but enough.
Do not rock that bucket so much.
I snap at it and get nothing.
Gold scales, and I swim slow.

lines.zh: 水里我滑得快，你抓不住。
lines.en: I slip fast in water. You cannot hold me.
My scales are hard. Do not push with your hands.
My scales glitter like a golden dragon's.
One touch and I shoot away.

lines.zh: 你的靴子踩到了我的尾。
lines.en: Your boot came down on my tail.

lines.zh: 你的网兜擦过我的背鳍。
lines.en: Your net drags across my dorsal fin.
A wave rolls between us.
Your pole knocked into me.
I circle once and look at you.

lines.zh: 河里有别的龙鱼，颜色不一样。
lines.en: There are other arowanas here, in other colors.

lines.zh: 白的、黑的、金的，都游在一起。
lines.en: White, black, and gold swim together.

lines.zh: 我们并排游，鳞片互相照。
lines.en: We swim abreast and our scales light each other.

lines.zh: 它们不认颜色，也不太认我。
lines.en: They ignore color, and mostly ignore me.

lines.zh: 有一尾跟了我一整条河。
lines.en: One of them followed me the length of a river.

lines.zh: 我们在水草里并排悬着。
lines.en: We hang side by side among the weeds.
Its scales shine brighter than mine.
The water muddied and we scattered.
Fish like us do not stay together long.
There will be more in the next stretch.
Something fell onto the surface.
I take it and spit it out.
An orb sank to the bed.
I nose it and it does not move.
I eat every small insect in the water.
Too bright. I leave it.
I carry it in my mouth a while.
What sinks belongs to the bed.
I have no hands, only a mouth.
Fallen fruit. I do not eat it.
A shadow moves on the surface.
Something is stirring the water.

lines.zh: 我一直在这块石头下面。
lines.en: I have been under this stone the whole time.

lines.zh: 他的腿在水里，我看得清。
lines.en: His legs are in the water and I see them plainly.
I drift closer, upstream.
My tail swept once.
The weeds block his line of sight.
In this bend he cannot back out.

lines.zh: 我听到他的靴子在水里。
lines.en: I hear his boots in the water.
He has put his hand down.
That hand. That one.

lines.zh: 我贴地滑过去，不惊动水。
lines.en: I slide along the bed without disturbing the water.

lines.zh: 他已经站进深水一点了。
lines.en: He has waded a little deeper.

lines.zh: 河底的沙在我身下散开。
lines.en: Sand scatters beneath me.
Now he is two body lengths away.

lines.zh: 我抬眼，水面上是他的脸。
lines.en: I look up. His face is on the surface.
I made one circle around him.
His eyes stay on the surface.
I pass beneath him.

lines.zh: 他往后退了一步，水响了。
lines.en: He stepped back and the water rang.
The light on the surface makes me easy to spot.
I drop into the shadow at the bottom.
He is looking for my color.
I stop and hold still.
His legs shift in the water.
I wait for him to bend down.
He bent down.
That puts him at the right distance.
I sweep my tail and let the water push me.
He reaches down into the water.
His hand is very close now.
He is still feeling about.
No sound now.
I move, fast.
I snap my jaws on his fingers.
My teeth face inward. Once set, they hold.
I strike his wrist.
He jerks his hand back and water flies.
I shake my head and pull him down.

lines.zh: 我的鳞在他皮肤上划开一道。
lines.en: My scales open a line on his skin.

lines.zh: 他从水里站起来，我咬住他的裤脚。
lines.en: He stands up and I catch his trouser leg.
My tail whips his calf.
He sits down hard in the water.

lines.zh: 我从水下撞他的膝盖弯。
lines.en: I strike the back of his knee from below.
This bite lands on the back of his hand.
Blood blooms in the water.
He retreats up the bank and I follow to the shallows.

lines.zh: 我跃出水面，咬住他垂下的手。
lines.en: I leap from the water and bite his dangling hand.
He tests the water with a foot again.
I catch his bootlace.
I slip out from under the stone.
My gold scales shine even in murky water.
A small ring spreads on the surface.
I make one pass along the shallows.
I lift the sand from the bed.

lines.zh: 这条河的颜色，我配得上。
lines.en: I suit the colors of this river.
I put my head above the surface.
Leaves from the bank fall into the water.
One sweep of my tail and I move up.
Insects are circling on the surface.
I travel the crevices of the bed.
The water is clear enough to see the bottom.
I turn my body on its side.
I could stay in this water a long time.
I hold still and look at the bank.
My barbels probe out first.

lines.zh: 水面上的天，比我记得的亮。
lines.en: The sky above is brighter than I remember.
I sink slowly.
The surface burned and I drove for the bottom.

lines.zh: 水被抽干，我摔在河床上。
lines.en: The water drained and I fell onto the bed.

lines.zh: 我被按在水里，腮动不起来。
lines.en: Held under, my gills will not work.
The blast rolled me over underwater.

lines.zh: 一支鱼叉扎穿了我的背鳍。
lines.en: A harpoon went through my dorsal fin.

lines.zh: 怪光在水里烧着我的鳞。
lines.en: Strange light burns my scales underwater.

lines.zh: 水面上再没有虫子落下。
lines.en: No more insects fall on the surface.

lines.zh: 雷落进水里，我全身僵了。
lines.en: Lightning struck the water and my whole body locked.

lines.zh: 河底裂开，我掉进黑水里。
lines.en: The bed split and I dropped into black water.
